string.name: desc
string.value:
Swings the polearm to deal a powerful attack on many enemies. The attack ignores a fixed about of enemy DEF and all attacks will become critical hits.
Can only be used #cafter using Triple Swing#.
[Command: Triple Swing + #cDown Arrow Key + Attack Key#]
Required Skill: #Triple Swing Lv. 20#
